supportDraft.subject: Urgent: Midpoint inbound/status webhook delays and queued bot replies
supportDraft.body: Please investigate delayed inbound WhatsApp messages, status updates and bot replies for Midpoint Hub / Midpoint Cafe, bot 474865, public business number +27 69 042 0108, WABA 1743148910251337, phone-number ID 1429672250221978. On 15 October 2026 SAST, a menu recorded as sent at 09:24 has a provider delivery acknowledgement at 10:05. The customer receives several greeting/menu replies together; a Functions selection sent at 10:22 with two ticks is absent from the refreshed WhatChimp inbox, which still ends at 10:21. Earlier Functions selections were recorded at 10:10 and 10:11 with their submenu replies. The contact is subscribed, inside 24 hours, and the bot is not paused. Midpoint phone Sync at 09:15 succeeded; account/phone statuses were Active/Approved/High/ONBOARDED and Meta showed Connected/High. A targeted Reset User Input Flow succeeded, removing an obsolete question session that had consumed MENU as an answer. Current MENU2169689 has zero chat input campaigns and uses native Functions form42768; direct full-form launcher2169721 was accepted around10:29 and the complete form was subsequently visible open in the WhatsApp desktop client. Please check Meta webhook receive/ack timestamps, retries, processing queues, outgoing send/response IDs and rate limits for this phone, identify the exact cause, and provide the repair. Preserve existing flows/forms/credentials and the separate Stor24 account; do not make production changes without approval. No customer conversation contents or credentials are attached.

evidenceLimits: Provider timestamps are minute precision and may represent processing times.
Reported delivery acknowledgement lag does not independently identify the failing service.
Unpublished FOND app1379541617167034 has a website callback and subscribed messages; its role in the active WhatChimp route is unverified, so it was not modified.
Direct form delivery does not prove MENU/submenu latency has recovered.
A manual TEST receiver execution13627 was accepted by SMTP and the labelled email was opened in Michelle's mailbox at10:28; this is separate from native form submission.
